Hi, I'm Linnea, and I live in Stockholm. Many visitors ask me what they should do here. My first tip: take a boat. Stockholm is on fourteen islands, and the city looks beautiful from the water. In summer, go to the countryside and swim in a lake. The water is cold, but it's very clean. If you would like to see the northern lights, you need to go to the far north, in winter. It's a long trip, but it's worth it. And please, try a local dish. Everybody knows our meatballs, but my favorite is a cinnamon bun with a coffee in the afternoon. We call this break fika.

Hello, I'm Callum, and I'm a tour guide in Edinburgh. Every morning I start my tour at the castle. It's on a big rock, so the view of the city is fantastic. Most of my visitors want to see the castle first. In the afternoon, we walk down the old street to the palace. Twice a week, I also do a day trip to the Highlands. We leave at eight in the morning and come back at eight at night. We see the countryside, the mountains and Loch Ness. Everybody would like to see the monster. I don't think it's real, but I always tell people: maybe today!
